person.title: Data Engineer
person.experience_summary: Six years in data engineering, the last three at Halcyon Retail. Rebuilt the nightly sales pipeline in dbt and Airflow and cut its run time from five hours to forty minutes.

role.title: Senior Data Engineer
role.description: The data team moves claims data from clinics into the warehouse every night and keeps it right.
highlights: Builds batch pipelines in Airflow or Dagster
Writes production SQL and dbt models
Has owned a pipeline on call

data.intro: We have three data roles open at Northwind Health, and the pipeline work you did at Halcyon Retail lines up with two of them.
